column1: # tools/deb/manifest.tsv: every file the Debian packages ship, one row each (PKG-MANIFEST). Read by
# tools/deb/build.sh and system.sh (they install exactly these rows), by tools/deb/check.sh and
# check-system.sh (every row is shipped with its mode, link target, contents and strip state, and
# nothing else is) and by tools/deb/root-system.sh, all through tools/deb/manifest.py, whose `lint`
# (run by the build, the checks and crates/core/tests/deb_manifest.rs) refuses a malformed or
# unsorted row. No spec clause: release packaging.
# Columns, tab-separated: flavour, package, path, kind, source, mode, strip, note.
#   flavour  system (tools/deb/build.sh --flavour system), coexist (the default flavour) or both. A
#            both row names the system package (libc6 or libc6-dev) and path; the coexist flavour
#            ships it in niji6 or niji6-dev under the sysroot usr/lib/niji/.
#   path     the installed path, relative to /; DEBIAN/<name> is a maintainer script.
#   kind     file (a product of `cargo xtask so`), text (a file under tools/deb/, copied), gzip (a
#            file under tools/deb/, gzip -9n), link (a symbolic link), changelog (the package's
#            changelog, written by the build), dir (an empty directory).
#   source   the product's name (file; <dir>/<name> for a file of a product directory, such as
#            charmaps/<name>: every file of that directory then needs a row), the file under
#   mode     the octal mode; - for a link.
#   strip    for a file: unneeded (strip --strip-unneeded, .comment and .note removed), debug (as
#            unneeded, after its symbol table and DWARF were copied into libc6-dbg, named by its
#            build-id: system flavour only), archive (strip --strip-debug, .comment removed,
#            deterministic archive) or none; none for every other kind.
#   note     what the row is for, - when the path says it.
# Every directory a path needs is shipped with mode 0755; the control members (control, md5sums,
# conffiles from the rows under etc/, triggers, symbols, shlibs) come from tools/deb/control.tsv.
# The rows are sorted (LC_ALL=C sort), so stories adding different rows merge without a conflict.
